report: Independent vision dataset/evaluation integrity audit - barter-platform-ai

pinned_revisions_reviewed.117095126641342a859725cf3060b77132468200: fail-closed guards, quarantine ledger, provenance recovery, doc corrections

methods.name: File/hash inventory verification
methods.method: SHA-256 every file under vision/data/yolo3/images/{train,val} and labels/{train,val}; compare sets and digests to vision/evaluation/integrity_audit.json records; SHA-256 every file in vision/evaluation/legacy62_v1 against its manifest.json; SHA-256 vision/models/material_v2_best.pt against manifest.deployed_weights_sha256.
methods.result: 260 train + 62 val on disk, sets and all digests match audit records; snapshot 62/62 verified; deployed weights 7397ac93f67c9b66... match manifest.

methods.name: Byte-identity duplicate scan (independent)
methods.method: Group all 322 yolo3 images by SHA-256; classify groups as cross-split / within-train / within-val.
methods.result: 0 cross-split byte-identical groups; 6 within-train groups, each a wood_swed__* and wood_zan__* pair with identical bytes; 0 within-val.

methods.name: Label consistency scan
methods.method: Parse dataset3.yaml class-index map; assert every label file's class index equals its filename class prefix for all 322 files; count label box shapes.
methods.result: 0 mismatches. Conflicting pairs confirmed: identical bytes labeled '21 0.5 0.5 1.0 1.0' (wood_swed) vs '22 0.5 0.5 1.0 1.0' (wood_zan). ALL 322 labels are full-image boxes (0.5 0.5 1.0 1.0): evaluation is whole-image classification through a detector, not localization.

methods.name: Training-lineage contamination check
methods.method: SHA-256 all images in vision/evaluation/retained_yolo2_evidence/images/{train,val}; intersect with current yolo3 val and train hash sets.
methods.result: 46/62 current val images byte-identical to retained dataset2 TRAIN images; 7/62 match retained val only; only 9/62 are new since dataset2 (listed: wood_zan_eg_{f5692109,ad9d6091,7ae5e282,cc6b985f,fedc55dd,f30c296d,ae546394}, copper_scrap_eg_e1eaa795, brick_white_eg_48bae6ff). Current train: 166/260 in retained train, 32/260 in retained val. Retained dataset2 itself had 1 image in both its splits.

methods.name: Deployed-weight lineage from the artifact itself
methods.method: Open material_v2_best.pt as zip; regex raw data.pkl for training metadata (no torch needed).
methods.result: Embedded train args reference data=dataset2.yaml, run name train3, timestamp 2026-11-22T12:34:49+02:00. Deployed weights were trained on the dataset2 pool containing 46 of the 62 'holdout' images as training data. Consequence: mAP figures 0.944/0.8847/0.8678 and train7's 0.8614 are predominantly memorization measurements, not generalization evidence.

methods.name: Membership history from git objects
methods.method: git show <commit>:vision/data/split_v1.json for 02766e7, cdd8e0c, f055f40, 8fbc1ff, ddba5ab, a3b3424, 2bb8b33, 67ce2ec; diff unique (class, filename) val sets; compare final set to on-disk yolo3/images/val.
methods.result: 55 unique (55 listed) -> 60 unique (107 listed; +8 incl. wood_zan_eg_4d7a562b added under wood_swed, -3) -> unchanged twice -> 62 unique (62 listed; +brick_white_eg_48bae6ff, +copper_scrap_eg_e1eaa795, aluminum_shavings_eg_db1a10e3 relabeled copper_scrap->copper_red) -> stable since. Matches builder's membership_history exactly. 'brick_red 10->5 erosion' explanation confirmed withdrawn (was duplicated manifest entries, not file removals). Current split_v1.json == on-disk val.

methods.name: Provenance/Egyptian-origin scan
methods.method: Parse vision/data/provenance2.csv (2028 rows); count source_page domains; list Wikimedia and non-Egyptian domains.
methods.result: 115 commons.wikimedia.org rows (e.g. steel_rebar_c000-c007 generic rebar photos) plus Gulf/Kuwait/Saudi scrap domains: q8scrap.com, scrapbuyerjeddah.com, buyingscrapksa.com, scrapbuyersmadinah.com, knuzskrab.com, skrabqmes.com, aacsiporex-sa.com, kayan-aldawlya.com, scrap-demolition-buildings.com, abualiscrap.com. Egyptian-only claim unsupportable (builder has withdrawn it).

methods.name: Perceptual near-duplicate scan (auditor addition; builder checked bytes only)
methods.method: 16x16 average-hash (grayscale, PIL) for all 322 yolo3 images; flag train<->val pairs with Hamming distance <= 20; pixel-diff (PIL ImageChops after resize) the top candidates.
methods.result: 5 flagged pairs, 3 distinct val images affected: (1) val plastic_shredded__plastic_shredded_eg_5df2bbfb.jpg <-> train plastic_pet__plastic_pet_eg_60702087.jpg, Hamming 0, same photo at 768x384 vs 800x400 (mean abs diff 6.46) - CROSS-SPLIT AND CROSS-CLASS (shared elmahal.com/scrap-plastic page); (2) val plastic_jerrican__plastic_jerrican_os001.jpg <-> train os007 (Hamming 10, mean abs diff 2.06, 97.8% pixels near-identical); (3) val os002 <-> train os005 (Hamming 10). Same product photos recompressed. Exact-byte screening understates cross-split leakage.

methods.name: Recovery-induced overlap check (auditor addition)
methods.method: Join vision/evaluation/provenance_recovery.json recovered source_pages by split; look for pages spanning train and val (integrity_audit.json overlaps were computed only from provenance2.csv, which lacks these rows).
methods.result: https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4416737 supplies BOTH train cement_bags__cement_bags_eg_a6b617e3.jpg AND val cement_bags__cement_bags_eg_4b7d281e.jpg - a 5th cross-split source-page overlap not in the audit JSON. Both files are byte-verified renames of files originally harvested as steel_rebar from that news page; val steel_rebar__steel_rebar_eg_9d258b98.jpg and steel_sheet__steel_sheet_eg_d0a82853.jpg are renames of steel_sections_* files (beshaysteel.com). No image-content evidence in-repo justifies these class moves. 4 plywood files remain UNRESOLVED.

methods.name: Independent source-component count
methods.method: Union-find over all 322 audit records linking files sharing any source_page.
methods.result: 150 components vs quarantine_ledger.json's claimed 146 (likely URL normalization; unreconciled, minor). Ledger status NO_APPROVED_TRAINING_POOL, eligible_for_training=0, originals preserved - verified consistent with records.

methods.name: Safeguard commit review (1170951)
methods.method: git diff 67ce2ec..1170951; read integrity_guard.py, audit_loader.py, loader_audit.json, execution_status.json, dataset3.yaml, SCORECARD.md, HOLDOUT_FREEZE.md.
methods.result: Fail-closed guards and blocked status verified at 1170951. Validation points to quarantined legacy62_v1, and current documentation withdraws old scores and treats Nov 26 as a checkpoint, not closure.

headline_conclusions: No valid estimate of deployed vision model real-world performance exists: the 'frozen holdout' is 46/62 byte-identical to the deployed weights' own training pool, plus at least 3 perceptual near-dups and 5 shared source pages across splits; the set was also adaptively reused for candidate selection.

No approved training pool exists: 6 conflicting-label duplicate pairs, cross-class near-dups, 32 ex-validation images in train, 115 Commons rows and Gulf sources contradicting the Egyptian-market rule.
Builder self-reports were accurate on every point independently tested; auditor's additions: M8 near-dups, M9 fifth overlap page + relabel-without-evidence, M10 component-count discrepancy.
Remediation posture (quarantine, guards, withdrawn claims) verified genuine in commit 1170951.
limitations: Ultralytics loader audit (loader_audit.json) is builder-generated; auditor verified its underlying disk facts (counts, uniqueness, label-prefix match) but did not re-run YOLODataset (read-only, no torch).

Retained dataset2 is not cryptographically bound to the historical training run; .pt-embedded metadata (dataset2.yaml/train3/date) plus 46/62 byte-identity is strong corroboration, not proof of exact batch membership.
Deployed==train3/best.pt hash equality rests on builder-recorded evidence (train3 weights not committed).
authorship: Independent technical review, separate from implementation work
scope: Vision artifact integrity only. This is not product certification or independent verification of NER, pricing, RAG or backend quality.
technical_extract_note: Technical findings and review limitations are preserved. Later corrections and count reconciliation are separately attributed in INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_FOLLOWUP.md.
